name: Side arm raise, left arm
setup: Face the camera about two metres back so it sees your hips and hands.
cues: Let your arm float up as if it’s resting on water.
Notice the moment your arm starts to feel heavy.
Keep your shoulder soft and away from your ear.
Lower it as slowly as you raised it.

name: Side arm raise, right arm
setup: Face the camera about two metres back so it sees your hips and hands.
cues: Let your arm float up as if it’s resting on water.
Feel your shoulder blade glide as the arm rises.
Breathe out as the arm comes down.
Lower it as slowly as you raised it.

name: Standing side bend
setup: Face the camera, feet hip-width apart, arms by your sides. Slide one hand down the outside of your leg until you feel a stretch along your side, then rise back up. Switch sides each time, like the figure.
cues: Slide your hand down your leg like honey dripping.
Feel the long side of your body open.
Rise back to standing just as slowly.
Keep your hips still. Only your upper body leans.

name: Slow squat, side-on
setup: Stand side-on to the camera, either side works, so it sees your whole body from head to feet.
cues: Sit back as if a chair is very far away.
Feel your weight spread across your whole foot.
Rise like you’re being lifted by a thread.
No rush at the bottom. Pause there if you like.
